difficulty_reason: Extends scalars to a finite extension l/k via a point of the smooth cover U_{x_0}, transfers the problem to the deformation category over l, reduces Inf to T by inserting the R = U x_X U diagonal (Inf embeds in the tangent space of the fibre product stack, which is representable by a smooth algebraic space), then bounds the tangent space explicitly: the deformation functor of the cover scheme U is controlled by a finite-type affine Spec(R), the m_R-adic generators f_1..f_n determine all maps to l[epsilon], so the tangent space has dimension at most n.
